heading: Wednesday, February 18, 2026
topLine: Google brings Lyria 3 music model to the Gemini app.

items.headline: Google brings Lyria 3 music model to the Gemini app
items.summary: Lyria 3 is Google DeepMind's generative music model. In the Gemini app it creates 30-second tracks with auto-generated lyrics from a text prompt or photo. It rolled out in beta to users 18 and older, and all output carries a SynthID watermark.
